explanation: The theorem is a birthday-style collision bound for the product measure `Measure.pi`. It says the probability that two distinct coordinates land in the same set `A a` is at most C(|I|,2) · Σ ν(A a)². I grepped Mathlib for `choose 2` together with `Measure.pi`, and for "collision". The only hits were unrelated files in algebra, category theory and number theory. Mathlib has no declaration that states this bound. The proof combines `measureReal_biUnion_finset_le`, `measureReal_iUnion_fintype_le` and a library-local lemma, `finite_coordinates_mass`. Together these make it too substantial to count as a one- or two-line special case of a single Mathlib declaration.
